::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
ADI's India centres design high-performance analog and mixed-signal ICs. Bengaluru is a key hub for precision converter and amplifier design.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Precision data converters (ADC/DAC), amplifiers, power management, RF transceivers, and DSP processors for industrial and communications applications.
